name: TruckloadDispatchConsole
tagline: Pair every load with the right driver, tractor and trailer – with hours, equipment and double-booking checks and the whole trip in Power Apps.
description: A complete truckload dispatch app for carriers and private fleets: a dispatch board pairs each load with a driver, tractor and trailer and checks every assignment for double bookings, driver hours left, trailer type, hazmat / TWIC qualifications and units in maintenance; ranked driver suggestions, a 72-hour driver timeline and an equipment view help fill the gaps, and the trip runs from dispatched through at pickup, in transit and at delivery to delivered with POD, with check-call reminders, exceptions and late / ETA flags. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Driver + tractor + trailer assignment with live conflict checks
Driver hours left vs drive hours + buffer (planning aid)
Trailer type vs equipment and hazmat / TWIC / tanker qualification checks
Units in maintenance / out of service and drivers off duty blocked
Ranked driver suggestions with a free tractor and matching trailer
72-hour driver timeline with conflict striping and Give a load
Trip lifecycle: dispatch, recall, at pickup, loaded (seal), at delivery, delivered (POD, OS&D)
Check-call reminders, exceptions, late pickup / delivery and ETA flags
Dispatch board with validated drag and drop; bulk dispatch with skipped-load reasons
KPIs: unassigned, conflicts, on the road, late, on-time %, utilisation, loaded miles, revenue per mile
Roles: dispatcher, fleet manager (overrides), viewer; history and undo
Power Fx outputs and events (NewRecordJson for every change), DispatchCsv and SummaryJson
